verdict.rationale: The CLI and REST API are documented as covering the full instance lifecycle, backed by a published OpenAPI spec and a Python SDK. The CLI hello-world walks through the whole loop: search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect, copy data, and clean up. A first-party `vastai` agent skill lets AI assistants create instances directly, and scoped API keys support unattended automation. missing for 10: explicit monitoring/metrics/log-retrieval APIs beyond waiting for boot, an official MCP server (only an agent skill is evidenced), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven end-to-end runs, and programmatic account onboarding (signup, email verification and initial top-up go through the web console).
